This consolidation is current to February 3, 2026.

values.where: internal note, not in the source

unsupported_wording: Partly too narrow. The s. 2(2) exclusion also lists other items, (a)-(b) not quoted here, besides commercial/industrial equipment: 'does not include computers and televisions that are part of or attached to any of the following: ... (c) commercial equipment that is not a product described in subsection (1); (d) industrial equipment that is not a product described in subsection (1).' So 'exclusion only for ... commercial or industrial equipment' is not supported. The exclusion also covers televisions. 'Servers not named' is supported: the word 'server' does not appear. IT coverage is supported: s. 2(1)(a)(i) 'computers, whether desktop, laptop, portable or part of other products'; (vi) 'other devices, equipment or media for collecting, storing, processing, presenting or communicating information'.
note: Reading servers as covered under (i)/(vi) is interpretation, as the claim says.
